subject.title: fix: resolve response prefix template variables in abort replies

question: Should maintainers repair this stale PR in place, replace it with a fresh current-main fix, or intentionally accept config-default-only abort prefixes?
rationale: The bug and direct-path proof are real, but the remaining correctness gap is how active model context should flow through routed abort delivery and override-aware sessions.

options.title: Repair before merge
options.body: Update the branch to pass active prefix context through routed abort delivery, seed from active session/channel model state, refresh against current main, and rerun focused proof.

options.title: Replace with a fresh fix
options.body: Keep the linked issue canonical and use a new current-main implementation if preserving this stale branch is not worth the conflict and review churn.

options.title: Accept default-only mitigation
options.body: Merge the narrower behavior while explicitly accepting that routed or override sessions can still show raw or stale model/thinking prefix state.

recommendation.title: Repair before merge
recommendation.body: Update the branch to pass active prefix context through routed abort delivery, seed from active session/channel model state, refresh against current main, and rerun focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared reply-prefix helper and recent reply/dispatch history make this the closest available owner signal for the branch-path decision.
